reviews.comment: If you need an Language, Philosophy and Culture credit TAKE HER CLASS. There is no final exam in the class and all the work is incredibly easy. The only real downside to the class, maybe is that you do have to do a bit of reading every single week but it is nothing too hard to handle. She is extremely nice and her lectures are pretty fun as well.

She was awesome! I made one of my closest friends in this class because she incorporates chill in-class work (typically ungraded) that gives students the opportunity to get to know one another and genuinely learn and use creativity. Her class is Monday Wednesday Friday, but she canceled all Friday classes as a "work day."
